TANTRA REIKI FROM OSHO — RESEARCH
I would like to offer a description of the nine levels of Tantra Reiki, which we recently explored together with Masters.
Each level of Tantra Reiki is a deeper entry into the Cosmic Flow of Creativity and Love.
Tantra Reiki is not simply a system of pleasant energy; it is a profound system of transformation, unlike anything else I have encountered.
This system is based on the Vedic philosophy of the trinity: Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma.
Tantra Reiki Level 1.
Within these energies, the whole world around you becomes delicious and fluid, and a pleasant wave of delight begins to ripple through your body.
It is as though you open a spring of the healing energy of Life, gently cleansing you and awakening your inner strength.
Tender, ecstatic pleasure spreads through the entire body and begins to awaken feelings and emotions.

OSHO TANTRA REIKI

It is believed that Osho is the author of Tantra Reiki. Tantra Reiki is the energy of love, unconditional love itself, embracing mind, spirit and body. Therefore practice consists in learning to feel, receive and direct energies. Reiki is the universal energy that comes to us from outside and nourishes us with life force. Yet alongside external energy every person has an internal source of vitality. Both flows, external and internal, participate equally in our lives. Tantra works with our primal (sexual) energy, transforming and directing it towards the unfolding of human potential and spiritual growth. It is not only a healing practice but also, in this traditional account, a way to harmonise emotions and Yin and Yang energies, create harmonious living space and support personal growth. The main chakras involved are Muladhara, Svadhisthana and Anahata. The original text states that Tantra Reiki healing is usually very gentle and without healing crises. It claims that regular practice can cure various urogenital illnesses, unlock inner reserves, increase attraction to the opposite sex and improve relationships. It further claims that working with this energy removes many psychological barriers to communication and complexes in the sexual sphere. Tantra Reiki is said to help a person find harmony between masculine and feminine aspects. In the source's gendered language, men become more masculine and women more feminine, while also strengthening the qualities of the opposite pole: men become more receptive, women more resilient and purposeful.

Traditional applications claimed for Tantra Reiki: harmonising Yin and Yang energies; working with situations; personal relations with the opposite sex; healing (described as gentle and rather gradual); increased attraction to the opposite sex; curing various urogenital illnesses; more vivid and intense sexual experiences; reduced stress, including stress linked to sexual dissatisfaction; awakening Kundalini; improved relationships; and release of inner reserves, whether extrasensory abilities, physical qualities or creativity.

Initiation into Tantra Reiki includes nine levels, each reinforcing the previous one. The interval between receiving each initiation is at least five to seven days. Throughout the course you will discover something new and astonishing in yourself and others, and the world will delight you with new colours and discoveries. Gradually you will learn to feel and direct the energy wherever you need it in that moment. Upon receiving initiation into the ninth level, the student becomes a Tantra Reiki Master and gains the ability to initiate other people.
